positioning.oneLine: Local-first macOS disk intelligence with reviewable cleanup safety.
positioning.description: Scans a user-selected folder, explains disk usage, classifies cleanup risk with deterministic local rules, and moves confirmed cleanup-ready items to the Bin.

screenshots.alt: SpaceLens disk scan results with cleanup safety classifications

capabilities.claim: Scans metadata within a user-selected filesystem scope
Classifies cleanup risk with deterministic local rules
Moves only confirmed cleanup-ready targets to the Bin

limitations: Scans only folders explicitly selected by the user.
Cannot override macOS privacy, sandbox, permission, or filesystem errors.
Smart Scan focuses on known rebuildable caches and generated outputs rather than every application-specific location.
safetyBoundaries: Safety classifications are deterministic guidance and every exact path remains reviewable.
Cleanup moves eligible items to the Bin and never permanently erases files or empties the Bin.
No file contents or metadata are sent to an external service.
